title: 第一卷 第9章 改造计划开始啦
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季望棉：“可是我不是女兵啊？这算不算占国家便宜！”

她可不像一来就落下一个贪便宜的名声，这对萧临戍的影响也不好。

王芬华大咧咧的一摆手：“这算什么，你看看谁不领，就像我们家金树，一年四套衣服，根本穿不过来，我就让他领大一号的衣服，拿回来裁裁，正好够俩皮小子的衣服，家家户户都这样，只要不过分，领导也是睁一只眼闭一只眼。”

季望棉乖巧地应了：“好，我回去问问他可不可以！”

王芬华也不强求，小姑娘面皮薄，谁不是从这个时候过来的呢！

“行，你回去问问，一会去我家我给你量一下尺寸，这布料做两身衣服，还能剩一些，你打算做什么？要不然给你一双手套？”

季望舒嘴巴甜甜的：“那怎么能行，剩下的布料你留着，给孩子做点东西，要不是手上没有，我都想把这布料让给孩子。”

要是上辈子的她，别说布料了，孩子从小到老死那天她都包了。

“他们不配！新裤子穿一天回来屁股给我磨两洞，气得我头晕，他们就该穿缝缝补补的衣服。”

季望舒捂嘴轻笑：“这么厉害？”

那够皮实的！

“你没生孩子，等你生了就知道了，不过你跟萧团长的孩子肯定听话，你还不知道吧，萧团长是大学生呢，还是京都那里的大学。”

季望舒确实有些意外。

“真的？那他没有跟我说。”

“咱们大院里只有两个大学生，一个是萧团长，还有一个是孙贝贝，她是为了萧团长是大学的，都学晕了，我看这大学是真不好考。”

季望舒眼神闪了闪：“为了萧临戍？”

王芬华身体一僵，悄悄拍了两下自己的嘴，又连忙解释：“大妹子，你可别误会，不能回去跟萧团长闹，是孙贝贝喜欢他，萧团长已经拒绝好多次了，最后没办法，萧团长说他喜欢大学生，孙贝贝还真去考了，没想到还考上了，正好咱们这里有一个推荐名额，就在咱们省上。”

季望舒倒是没把孙贝贝当回事，但是知己知彼百战百胜。

“你可别闹，这男人不闹还没事，一闹起来，到时候。”

“芬华姐，你能跟我说说孙贝贝吗？我想知道她是什么样的女孩子，喜欢萧临戍一定是一件很辛苦的事情，我很佩服她！”

王芬华的话被打算，有一瞬间空耳，再三确定自己没听错的时候，只觉得眼前一黑又一黑。

这傻姑娘，人家要抢她男人，她还心疼上了，不行，她得多看着点，省得哪天被欺负了。

王芬华倒也没有添油加醋，把孙贝贝的事情说了一遍，顺便说了家庭成员。

总的来说。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ji Wangmian: "But I'm not a female soldier? Does this count as taking advantage of the country?"

It's not like she had a reputation as someone who was greedy for gain as soon as she arrived, and this would not have a good impact on Xiao Linshu.

Wang Fenhua waved his hands carelessly: "What does this mean? Look at who doesn't accept it. Just like our Jinshu, who has four sets of clothes a year and can't wear them at all. I asked him to get clothes one size larger and cut them just enough for two little boys. It's like this in every household. As long as it's not excessive, the leaders will turn a blind eye."

Ji Wangmian responded obediently: "Okay, I'll go back and ask him if it's okay!"

Wang Fenhua doesn't force it either, the little girl is thin-skinned, who hasn't come from this time!

"Okay, you go back and ask. I will measure you at my house later. I can make two sets of clothes with this fabric. There is still some left. What are you going to do? Or give you a pair of gloves?"

Ji Wangshu said sweetly: "How can that be done? You can keep the remaining fabric and make something for the child. If I didn't have it on hand, I would give the fabric to the child."

If it were her in her previous life, not to mention fabrics, she would have covered her children from childhood to the day they died of old age.

"They don't deserve it! After wearing the new trousers for a day, I had two holes in my butt, which made me dizzy with anger. They should wear mended clothes."

Ji Wangshu covered his mouth and chuckled: "So powerful?"

That's pretty solid!

"You haven't given birth to a child. You will know when you do, but your and Captain Xiao's child will definitely be obedient. You don't know yet, right? Captain Xiao is a college student, or a university in Kyoto."

Ji Wangshu was indeed a little surprised.

"Really? Then he didn't tell me."

"There are only two college students in our compound, one is Captain Xiao, and the other is Sun Beibei. She went to college because of Captain Xiao, and she got dizzy from studying. I think this university is really difficult to get into."

Ji Wangshu's eyes flashed: "For Xiao Linshu?"

Wang Fenhua stiffened, quietly patted her mouth twice, and explained quickly: "Sister, don't get me wrong, you can't go back and make trouble with Captain Xiao. It's Sun Beibei who likes him. Captain Xiao has rejected him many times. In the end, there was nothing he could do. Captain Xiao said he liked college students, and Sun Beibei actually took the exam. Unexpectedly, he got admitted. It just so happens that we have a recommended quota here, and it's in our province."

Ji Wangshu didn't take Sun Beibei seriously, but if he knew himself and his enemy, he would be victorious in any battle.

"Don't make a fuss. This man will be fine if he doesn't make a fuss. If he starts making a fuss, that's when the time comes."

"Sister Fenhua, can you tell me about Sun Beibei? I want to know what kind of girl she is. It must be very hard to like Xiao Linshu. I admire her very much!"

Wang Fenhua's words were thought out, and her ears were empty for a moment. When she made sure that she heard correctly, she felt that her eyes were going dark again and again.

This silly girl feels bad for someone who wants to steal her man. No, she needs to keep an eye on her to avoid being bullied one day.

Wang Fenhua didn't add any exaggeration. She told Sun Beibei's story and family members by the way.

Overall.
